title: Ooltha
extract:
The Ooltha is a  Slash-focused Strike used in Zaw construction.

Acquisition
The Ooltha blueprint can be acquired after reaching the Rank of Neutral with the Ostrons and buying it from Hok for  1,000.

Characteristics
This Strike deals primarily  Slash damage.

10%  Impact
40%  Puncture
50%  Slash
Compatible weapon types:

Sword
Staff
